summary: Ubuntu 22.10 (Kinetic Kudu) was released on 20 October 2022. Features: GNOME 43, kernel 5.19, Mesa 22.2. The kudu is an African antelope; 'kinetic' evoked motion and energy. Focus on graphics and desktop refinements.
notes: Unsupported since 2023-07-20. Kernel 5.19. Interim release with standard 9-month support.
